cover.sub: It's not just what you order. See #5.

reasons.head: You show up starving
reasons.sub: Saving up all day for dinner out means you order more and eat faster.

reasons.head: You eat with a big group
reasons.sub: Eating with just one other person can make a meal 44% bigger, and more people means more.

reasons.head: You finish whatever they serve
reasons.sub: In one study, people ate 30% more from a bigger portion and didn't feel any fuller.

reasons.head: Dessert feels like part of the deal
reasons.sub: It's a night out, so dessert and a drink feel earned, even after a big meal.

reasons.head: You can't see the butter and oil
reasons.sub: In one study, diners underestimated their meals, and the bigger the meal, the bigger the miss.
